tests.name: The cumulative-mass map realizes nonempty atoms and periodic moments
All packet protocols equal the local cyclic heat operator
Uniform pre-failure masses give equal residue size but different excited orbit labels
One failure leaves exactly the predicted blind residue
Routing changes cost and elapsed time while preserving the mass dynamics
Role reassignment transfers boundaries without changing the mass spectrum
A disconnected snapshot blocks the update instead of claiming convergence
Large cases distinguish common quotient from service quotient

notes: Communication is explicit reliable synchronous store-and-forward with epoch barriers.
Ring routing is an ideal carrier and has no range guarantee.
Robot collision avoidance is not implemented.
Annulus motion uses feasible lifted polar coordinates; disk motion uses Euclidean centroid attraction.
